# explorer-verify

> explorer-verify verifies the source of deployed smart contracts on block explorers: Etherscan (API v2), Blockscout, Sourcify and Routescan, with one API for a browser, a backend or a CLI. Nothing is published to npm yet. `verify()` works with Sourcify, Etherscan v2, Routescan, Blockscout and standalone Etherscan-compatible explorers. The user docs grow with each feature. Once published, the npm package will ship these pages under `docs/` with its own `llms.txt`, so an agent working in `node_modules` reads the docs of the installed version.

Submitting a verification is outward and permanent. Read the agent page before you call the library or the CLI on someone's behalf.

## User docs

- [User documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/README.md): index of the user pages and the planned ones
- [Deploy a contract from a dapp and verify it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/tutorials/deploy-and-verify-from-a-dapp.md): tutorial: ship the build files with a dapp, deploy from a browser wallet on Sepolia, verify on Sourcify with no key, resume after a reload, read the result, and verify on Etherscan through the server handler
- [Using explorer-verify from an agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/using-from-an-agent.md): which calls and commands are safe and which submit, the target a submit needs (`--backend` or `--backend auto`), the dry run, where API keys come from, the stderr handle line, what to do on each exit code, and the Etherscan plan rule
- [Verify a contract shipped in an npm package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-a-contract-from-an-npm-package.md): build the verification input from build-info, artifacts, Standard JSON or Solidity metadata and sources of unknown origin
- [Verify contracts your package ships](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-contracts-your-package-ships.md): for an SDK that deploys its own contracts: ship the Standard JSON input and a manifest, load them with `import()` only when verification runs (an application that never verifies does not load them, and a browser does not fetch them), and call `verify()` with the address and the creation transaction hash, in a browser or on a backend
- [Verify a contract from a Hardhat project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-hardhat-project.md): `@explorer-verify/hardhat` finds a contract's artifact and build-info in a Hardhat 2 or Hardhat 3 project and builds the input
- [Verify from deployed bytecode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-deployed-bytecode.md): `buildVerifyInputFromBytecode` from `explorer-verify/resolve` reads the metadata hash in the bytecode, finds the metadata and sources on Sourcify or your IPFS gateway, checks every hash and builds the input
- [Verify a proxy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-a-proxy.md): verify the implementation, verify the proxy, then link them with `linkProxy()`: what Etherscan, Blockscout and Sourcify each do, the `linked` and `not-linked` results, and a link still pending
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/skills/explorer-verify/SKILL.md): the skill shipped in the package: build the input, verify, resume from the handle, read the result, the errors and the exit codes, and the key rules
- [Verify a contract from a Foundry project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-foundry-project.md): `@explorer-verify/foundry` finds a contract's artifact, build-info or sources under `out/` and builds the input
- [verify()](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/verify.md): what `verify()` does step by step, its options, results, errors and exit codes, how to resume after an abort, and `verifyEach()`, which verifies on several backends in one call with one outcome per backend
- [checkStatus()](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/check-status.md): resume a submitted verification from its handle, the handle's one-line form, `formatHandle`, `parseHandle`, `tryParseHandle` and `isHandleString`
- [API keys](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/api-keys.md): `apiKeys` and `route.apiKey`, which host gets each key, where in the request it goes, the environment variables the CLI will read, and the Etherscan plan rule
- [Routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/routing.md): how a chain resolves to a backend, the routing table and its checks, `route`, `allowSourcifyFallback`, and which host gets a key
- [Run the server handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/run-the-server-handler.md): `createVerifyHandler` in a Next.js App Router route and a Cloudflare Worker: the key from the platform's secret store, the guards, CORS and origin settings, the browser's `handlerUrl`, and Etherscan's terms
- [Verify from a browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-a-browser.md): with a bundler or a CDN import map, keyless explorers called directly, Etherscan through the server handler, the handle kept across a reload, and bundle size
- [Verify from Node.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-node.md): keys from the environment in `apiKeys`, a logger, events to telemetry, a long budget, `verifyEach()` on Etherscan and Sourcify at once, `checkStatus()` from a job queue, and Deno and Bun
- [Verify from an edge function](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-an-edge-function.md): a Cloudflare Worker that submits in one request and resumes with `checkStatus()` in later ones, with the key from the Worker's secrets
- [Verify from CI with the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/verify-from-ci-with-the-cli.md): write the request after a Foundry or Hardhat build, dry run, `--json` and `jq`, exit codes in a shell `case`, and keys from CI secrets
- [Wrap explorer-verify behind your tool's API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/guides/wrap-explorer-verify-in-your-tool.md): for a tool that already verifies contracts: call `verify()` and `checkStatus()` inside its existing functions, map its settings onto `VerifyOptions`, the behaviour that changes, a table that maps every error code, and tests that replay recorded answers through an injected `fetch`
- [Server handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/server-handler.md): `createVerifyHandler` from `explorer-verify/server`, which keeps the Etherscan key on your server and forwards only submit, status, a reduced lookup and, when turned on, the two proxy-link actions: its options, guards, who may verify, refusal codes and the Etherscan terms
- [Errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/index.md): the fields of every error, key redaction, exit codes, retries and the list of codes
- [Error `invalid-input`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/invalid-input.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `not-confirmed`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/not-confirmed.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unsupported-chain`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unsupported-chain.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `network`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/network.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `rate-limited`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/rate-limited.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `timeout`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/timeout.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unexpected-response`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unexpected-response.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `in-progress`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/in-progress.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unknown-state`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unknown-state.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `job-not-found`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/job-not-found.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `cancelled`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/cancelled.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `incomplete-input`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/incomplete-input.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `insufficient-artifact`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/insufficient-artifact.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `unsupported-compiler`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/unsupported-compiler.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `verification-inconclusive`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/verification-inconclusive.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `source-mismatch`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/source-mismatch.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `missing-api-key`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/missing-api-key.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `api-key-rejected`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/api-key-rejected.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `quota-exceeded`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/quota-exceeded.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `internal-error`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/internal-error.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `no-metadata-hash`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/no-metadata-hash.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `metadata-unavailable`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/metadata-unavailable.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `constructor-args-unavailable`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/constructor-args-unavailable.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `proxy-link-pending`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/proxy-link-pending.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `proxy-link-unknown-state`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/proxy-link-unknown-state.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [Error `handler-refused`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/errors/handler-refused.md): cause, fix, hint, whether to retry and exit code
- [JSON output and exit codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/json-output.md): the versioned JSON envelope, its JSON Schema and the exit code of every outcome
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/cli.md): the `explorer-verify` command: `verify`, `status`, `--dry-run` and `--input-json`, and from its help: examples, options, environment variables, exit codes, `--help` and `--version` with `--json`, stdout and stderr, log levels and colour
- [Sourcify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/sourcify.md): what is sent to Sourcify, how each answer becomes a result or an error, and its side effects
- [Etherscan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/etherscan.md): what is sent to Etherscan v2, how each `result` text becomes a result or an error, and Similar Match
- [Routescan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/routescan.md): what is sent to Routescan, its per-chain URL, the optional key in a header, and the answers it adds to Etherscan's
- [Blockscout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/blockscout.md): what is sent to a Blockscout instance, how each answer becomes a result or an error, partial matches, the empty-answer retry and rate limits
- [Etherscan-compatible explorers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/etherscan-compatible.md): what is sent to a standalone explorer that serves Etherscan's API on its own host, the key in `route.apiKey`, no `chainid`, and the retired Etherscan host answer
- [Match types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/explanation/match-types.md): what `exact` and `partial` mean per explorer, the metadata hash, builds that can only reach `partial`, automatic matching and why `verify()` looks up first
- [Etherscan plans and attribution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/explanation/etherscan-plans-and-attribution.md): which Etherscan plan a use needs, the "Powered by Etherscan.io APIs" rule, keys off the client and the server handler's position
- [Logging and events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/main/docs/user/reference/logging-and-events.md): the logger, the typed stage events, the event JSON Schema, and what happens when a callback throws
- [API reference](https://aelmanaa.github.io/explorer-verify/api/index.md): every export of each package, generated from TSDoc, for the version on npm `latest`; the `.d.ts` files of an installed package carry the same comments
